name: Searing Smite
summary: Adds Fire damage to a melee hit and sets the target burning until it succeeds on a save.

castingTime.trigger: immediately after hitting a target with a Melee weapon or an {ref:glossary/unarmed-strike}

stats.effect: As you hit the target, it takes an extra 1d6 Fire damage from the attack. At the start of each of its turns until the spell ends, the target takes 1d6 Fire damage and then makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the spell continues. On a successful save, the spell ends.
stats.higherLevels: All the damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 1.
